description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of average lagging (AL), with the x-axis labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" ranging from 2 to 8 on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "BLEU" ranging from 20 to 30, also on a linear scale. Four distinct models are compared: Consistency-CE (light purple dashed line with circles), Inconsistency-CE (dark purple dashed line with squares), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with squares), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with stars). The Consistency-Bi model consistently achieves the highest BLEU scores across all AL values, starting at approximately 25 BLEU at AL = 2 and increasing to nearly 30 BLEU at AL = 8. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model starts at a BLEU of about 22.5 at AL = 2 and rises to approximately 29.5 at AL = 8. The Inconsistency-CE model begins at a BLEU of around 22.5 at AL = 2 and reaches about 29.5 at AL = 8. The Consistency-CE model starts at a BLEU of approximately 20.2 at AL = 2 and increases to about 29.5 at AL = 8. All models show an increasing trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases.
